title: Top Recruiters
content: A stellar list of marquee recruiters visit the SRM campus annually. Top tier technology companies include Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Adobe, Cisco, PayPal, and Uber. Mass recruiters and major global consultants such as TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys, Capgemini, Accenture, LTIMindtree, and DXC Technology recruit hundreds of students. Product-based and financial organizations like Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, EY, and Barclays also hire heavily. For core branches, recruiters include Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, Bosch, Siemens, Reliance Industries, Hyundai, and Saint-Gobain.
